entries.name: CO2 hop extract
entries.notes: Non-isomerized lupulin extract. Each can is labelled with its alpha; 1 mL is about 10 IBU in 5 gal of 1.050 boiled 60 min. Variety-specific low-pressure extracts (e.g. Citra CO2 at 53.2%) keep more oil and are dosed in the whirlpool for aroma.

entries.name: Hop Shot
entries.notes: Non-isomerized lupulin extract sold in 10 mL syringes. Boil only. 1 mL is about 10 IBU in 5 gal of 1.050 boiled 60 min. Columbus, Centennial, Cascade/Willamette, and two blends (Cluster/Magnum) that carry no variety.

entries.name: Flex
entries.notes: Flowable lupulin extract targeted at 65% alpha, dosed early in the kettle. No vegetative matter, so the extract form scalar applies and the resin still needs the boil to isomerize.

entries.name: DynaBoost
entries.notes: Whirlpool flowable extract (formerly YCH 702). Typical dose 0.2-0.5 g/L; dilute 1:10 before dosing. YCH expects bitter pickup in the whirlpool to be negligible, so its primary use is flavour.

entries.name: Incognito
entries.notes: Whirlpool flowable extract. Dose 0.5-2.0 g/L with a 2.0 g/L maximum; 1 g is roughly 1 mL. Haas publishes a 1:6 T-90 replacement, which is more generous than the cooling curve prices it; see docs/hops/hop-products.md section 5.
